description: Returns active Common Alerting Protocol (CAP) weather and natural-hazard warnings from Veðurstofa Íslands (api.vedur.is/cap), returning an explicit empty state when none are active (max 20).

category.description: Optional CAP alert category filter (default all).

limit.description: Maximum active alerts to return (1-20, default 20).

region.description: Optional forecast area or keyword filter (e.g. Capital, South, Faxaflói, Westfjords, North, East).

name: get_weather_warnings
title: Get Active Weather & Hazard Warnings (CAP)
